I can’t reliably evaluate this long assignment sequence by hand. You can get the final values by running the assignments through a small interpreter:

```python
import re

program = r"""PASTE THE ASSIGNMENTS HERE"""

env = {}
for line in program.splitlines():
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    for statement in line.split(";"):
        match = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\w+)\s*<-\s*(\w+|\d+)\s*", statement)
        if match:
            target, source = match.groups()
            env[target] = env[source] if source.isidentifier() else int(source)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {env[name]}" for name in
                ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")))
```
